description: TXVALID: VALIDATE THE DAY'S TRANSACTION FILE
CHECKS THE FILE AS A WHOLE: A HEADER FOR TODAY'S BUSINESS
DATE FROM A KNOWN SOURCE, THE BRANCHES OR THE CARDS, THEN
DETAILS, THEN A TRAILER WHOSE CONTROL TOTALS MATCH THE
DETAILS. A FILE THAT FAILS THESE CHECKS IS NOT PROCESSED.
CHECKS EACH DETAIL'S FIELDS AND WRITES IT EITHER TO THE VALID
FILE OR TO THE REJECTS: THE ACCOUNT NUMBER, THE CODE, WHICH
MUST BE ONE ITS SOURCE SENDS, THE AMOUNT, AND FOR A TRANSFER
THE ACCOUNT IT GOES TO. WHETHER THE ACCOUNTS EXIST IS LEFT TO
POSTING, WHICH READS THE MASTER. THE REJECTS ARE APPENDED TO,
AS THE DAILY BATCH VALIDATES THE CARD FILE AFTER THE
BRANCHES'.
RETURN CODES: 0 ALL VALID, 4 SOME DETAILS REJECTED,
12 FILE REJECTED, 16 I/O ERROR.

records.name: BANK-CONTROL-RECORD
records.description: BANKCTL: BANK CONTROL RECORD, ONE PER FILE THE BUSINESS DATE THE BATCH RUNS FOR, NEVER THE CLOCK.

records.name: TRAN-RECORD
records.description: TRANREC: DAILY TRANSACTION FILE RECORD, 80 BYTES ONE HEADER, THE DETAILS, ONE TRAILER, TOLD APART BY THE RECORD TYPE. THE BODY IS REDEFINED FOR EACH RECORD TYPE. THE TRAILER CARRIES THE SENDER'S CONTROL TOTALS: THE DETAIL COUNT, THE SUM OF AMOUNTS AND THE SUM OF ACCOUNT NUMBERS. A TRANSFER (TR) NAMES THE ACCOUNT IT GOES TO. POSTING SPLITS IT IN TWO: THE DEBIT ON THE SENDING ACCOUNT, THEN A TRANSFER CREDIT (TC) ON THE RECEIVING ONE. A CREDIT THAT CANNOT POST GOES BACK AS A RETURNED TRANSFER (RT). TC AND RT ARE MADE BY POSTING, NEVER RECEIVED IN THE DAILY FILE. WHEN A MONTH CLOSES, THE BANK CREDITS ITS INTEREST (IN), CHARGES OVERDRAFT INTEREST (OD) AND THE MAINTENANCE FEE (MF). THESE TOO ARE NEVER RECEIVED IN THE DAILY FILE. THE CARD FILE, FROM THE ONLINE DAY'S HOLDS, HAS THE SAME FORM AND ITS OWN SOURCE: CARD PURCHASES (CP), ATM WITHDRAWALS (AW) AND ATM FEES (AF), WHICH WERE AUTHORIZED WHEN THEY WERE MADE. MODIFICATION HISTORY DATE       BY  CHANGE 1987-03-12 JA  ORIGINAL VERSION. 1991-06-03 PK  CR-0117 ACCOUNT NUMBER HASH IN THE TRAILER. 1996-04-15 PK  CR-0233 TRANSFERS: COUNTER ACCOUNT, FROM THE FILLER. 2001-09-03 TL  CR-0298 MONTH-END INTEREST AND FEE CODES. 2003-05-19 MV  CR-0342 THE CARD FILE AND ITS CODES.

records.name: REJECT-RECORD
records.description: REJREC: REJECTED TRANSACTION, 110 BYTES THE TRANSACTION AS RECEIVED, WITH THE STEP THAT REJECTED IT AND WHY. ACCOUNT MAINTENANCE REJECTS ITS REQUESTS IN THE SAME FORM, THE REQUEST IN PLACE OF THE TRANSACTION. THE DATE IT WAS REJECTED IS TEXT, YYYY-MM-DD, AS THE BRANCHES READ IT. MODIFICATION HISTORY DATE       BY  CHANGE 1987-03-12 JA  ORIGINAL VERSION. 1988-05-09 JA  CR-0031 ACCOUNT MAINTENANCE REASONS. 2009-03-02 MV  CR-0444 THE DATE OF THE REJECTION. RECORD WIDENED TO 110 BYTES.

paragraphs.name: 0000-MAIN
paragraphs.description: VALIDATE THE FILE AND SET THE RETURN CODE.

paragraphs.name: 1000-OPEN-FILES
paragraphs.description: OPEN THE FILES AND READ THE BUSINESS DATE. THE REJECTS ARE EXTENDED, AND CREATED IF NEW.

paragraphs.name: 2000-READ-HEADER
paragraphs.description: THE FIRST RECORD MUST BE THE HEADER FOR THE BUSINESS DATE, FROM A KNOWN SOURCE.

paragraphs.name: 3000-READ-DETAILS
paragraphs.description: VALIDATE EACH RECORD UNTIL THE TRAILER.

paragraphs.name: 3100-READ-NEXT
paragraphs.description: READ ONE RECORD. THE FILE MUST NOT END BEFORE ITS TRAILER.

paragraphs.name: 3200-VALIDATE-DETAIL
paragraphs.description: ADD A DETAIL TO THE TOTALS, THEN CHECK ITS FIELDS.

paragraphs.name: 3300-REJECT-RECORD
paragraphs.description: WRITE THE RECORD TO THE REJECTS WITH ITS REASON.

paragraphs.name: 4000-CHECK-TRAILER
paragraphs.description: THE TRAILER MUST MATCH THE TOTALS, AND END THE FILE.
